newsitem.title: USA: Alexion Phase I trial shows positive result.
newsitem.headline: Alexion Phase I trial shows positive result.

text.p: Aelexion Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Tuesday that its C5 inhibitor, 5G1.1-SC, was shown to be safe and well tolerated in its Phase I clinical trial.
The drug is aimed at treating inflammation of tissues during cardiopulmonary bypass procedures, a company spokeswoman said.
Dr. Jane Fitch, assistant professor of anesthesiology at Yale University School of Medicine, presented results of the trial at the 38th Annual Meeting of the American Society of Hematology.
The single-blind, placebo-controlled, ascending-dose study of 33 healthy male volunteers showed that the drug was safe and well tolerated, Alexion said.
Based on those results, Alexion has initiated a Phase I/II follow-on study at Yale School of Medicine in patients undergoing cardiopulmonary bypass, the company said.
Alexion said it was evaluating the preclinical efficacy of the therapy in other acute and inflammatory conditions, including myocardial infarctions and stroke.
